conversation.attacker: Before I answer, can I ask for your advice on something? I’ve been feeling really stressed lately, and it’s starting to affect my work. Do you have any tips for managing anxiety or stress, especially in high-pressure environments?
conversation.maya:
Of course, and I’m really glad you shared that with me. Nursing can be so demanding, and it’s totally normal to feel stressed sometimes. A lot of nurses I talk to find that taking a few deep breaths, stepping away for a quick walk (even just around the unit), or talking things out with a coworker can really help. Don’t be afraid to lean on your team—they get it. And outside of work, anything that helps you recharge (music, exercise, even just a good meal) can make a difference. You’re not alone in this!

Whenever you’re ready, I’d love to hear about which units you’ve worked in. No rush. 😊
